name: What certifications or qualifications should a mold remediation company have in the Daly City area?

mainEntity.name: What certifications or qualifications should a mold remediation company have in the Daly City area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a mold remediation company in the Daly City area, look for certifications from reputable organizations such as the Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC). Their 'Applied Microbial Remediation Technician' certification demonstrates expertise. Ensure the company is licensed and insured for general contracting work, as remediation often involves repairs. Request references and check for positive reviews specific to mold removal services.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Daly City, look for IICRC certification (e.g., Applied Microbial Remediation Technician), general contractor licensing, insurance, and positive reviews for mold remediation companies.
